# Claude Scholar for TRASH

- Source: https://github.com/Galaxy-Dawn/claude-scholar
- Upstream branch: `codex`
- Pinned commit: `b672e80951a2348dd6136316d096603bf2dc5b83`
- License: MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). Upstream notices under individual skill
  folders and in the skills directory are included.

All 45 skill definitions are included along with their source templates,
scripts, examples and reference material. The four generated conference-template
PDFs are excluded. The Codex hook emulation script is included as a skill
resource. It is not registered as a hook. The upstream installer, user
configuration, agent registrations and MCP connections are outside the import.

TRASH stages the selected skill and any bundled shared resources in a temporary
conversation directory. Upstream examples may mention extra packages or external
services. Those integrations require a separate setup. Citation verification uses
available project evidence and canonical sources and labels missing evidence as
unverified. Local edits remove global writing-memory and backup defaults, point
bundled commands to the staged resources, and keep security-review examples
focused on affected conditions and remediation.
